text:
maria: Saturday plans — quick question: garden potluck at the community plot (11am) or stay home and finally do the existential pile of laundry? 🪴🧺
jamal: Garden for me if someone brings empanadas. I will fight for empanadas. :raised_hands:
sophia: I can bring a mason jar salad and forks. Also +1 for sunscreen.
alex: Oof wedding rehearsal all day, but if you start earlier I might swing by for 30 mins.
noah: Laundry is tempting but garden sounds nicer. I can bring a blanket and the cheap bluetooth speaker.
maria: @jamal you are hereby deputized to secure empanadas. :) quick sign-up: https://short.link/garden-potluck (add what you bring)
jamal: on it. thinking 8x mini empanadas from La Casa — anyone allergic to cilantro?
sophia: cilantro ok for me. also bringing tongs + reusable plates.
alex: (reaction :thumbsup:) would someone mind saving me a spare fork?
maria: saved — @alex fork reserved.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Community Garden Potluck" • Saturday 11:00 AM — 12:30 PM — Reminder set for 1 hour before
noah: tiny logistics Q — which gate do we meet at?
maria: Meet at the shed by the west gate (map pin in thread). I'll post exact coordinates in thread 10 min before.
jamal: If rain forecast looks bad by Friday, fallback is pancake brunch at Myrta's Diner.
sophia: Poll time: garden :seedling: — 5 votes, laundry :shirt: — 0 votes (so far)
alex: Big fan of both but I choose love -> garden. Good luck, laundry pile.
maria: Perfect. See you Saturday! If anyone needs a ride DM me.
noah: also — tiny meme for motivation: "Laundry: you fold, it multiplies" :joy:
